results.name: Related documents and modules become two actions without discarding their individual steps
Missing, renewal and office-request tasks for the same document collapse to one item while retaining notes
Overdue and today items come first and no urgent group is hidden in More
Document day deadlines use the supplied site date, not midnight UTC or the browser clock
Office checks are collapsed, deduplicated and never lead a worker into admin or back to the list
Urgent office cover stays visible before the collapsed office section
Only one upcoming visit is shown and a visit already needing action is not repeated
Completed tasks disappear and the empty state does not claim that office reviews are finished
Email verification has a direct user action; coordinators are never offered resend for their own account
Distinct visit requests stay distinct; task and person text are escaped
Office list fetches its paginated queue once and keeps assignment forms collapsed
Secondary workflow tools remain accessible inside one collapsed menu
Resend requests use the existing endpoint and show requested rather than unconfirmed delivery
